title: 工具：墨卡托投影 ↔ 等积地球投影
author: Simon Willison
content:
7th September 2026

Tool Mercator ↔ Equal Earth — View an interactive animated map that morphs between Mercator and Equal Earth projections using a slider or play button. The visualization demonstrates how different map projections represent the world, with controls to blend between the two projection types and observe how they preserve different geographic properties.

I got curious about the Equal Earth map projection that was recently voted on at the UN so I had GPT-6 Astra (medium) in ChatGPT Work build me this animated transition between Mercator and Equal Earth using D3.

summary: Simon Willison 分享了他开发的一个工具，该工具通过交互式动画过渡来可视化墨卡托投影与等积地球投影之间的差异。该工具是利用 D3 和 ChatGPT Work 中的 GPT-6 Astra 创建的，允许用户通过滑块或播放按钮在两种投影之间进行融合，从而突显每种投影如何保留不同的地理属性。这篇文章的灵感源于近期联合国关于世界地图投影的一次投票。
